notes.title: Fixes and Improvements - Post-Launch Update #1

tags.feature: [*]Items which can be shared by every party member are indicated in their description;
[*]Inside the inventory or shops, item backgrounds turn red if an item can’t be equipped by the currently selected character;
[*]Recommended heroes now have a star icon added to their portrait;
[*]The Talent section of the inventory has a different  background;
[*]There’s now an option to disable the grunts when selecting a character and adjust its volume;
[*]The filling inside regions highlighted had been fixed, and an inner glow has been added to make it more comfortable to the eye;
[*]The position of a Recommended hero’s dialog during party selection has been adjusted;
[*]There are now tooltips informing players about the Gravely Wounded status, what it does and how to cure it;
[*]There’s a tutorial for inspecting enemies in the second combat at “Failed Vows”;

tags.balance_change: [*]The animation speed of interactive objects has been adjusted. Players can now move right after breaking something;

tags.feature: [*]In the “House of Penance” quest, when the player pulls the lever that activates the traps, the camera moves to show what happened;

tags.bug: [*]Problems with the grid when using “Sacred Ground”, “Mind Trick”, “Holy Word”, “Weakness”, “Phantasm”, “Bless Armor” and “Bless Weapon” close to walls or blocked areas have been solved;
[*]The “missing click” error with the “Firewall” skill has been resolved;
[*]Inconsistencies with the “Taunt” skill depending on the location have been solved;
[*]The issue with character speeches which didn’t change properly in cutscenes has been addressed;

tags.feature: [*]The color of the “Equippable by” text has been changed to red when reading the tooltip;

tags.bug: [*]Items are no longer accidentally discarded by dropping them between slots on inventory and shops;

tags.feature: [*]Preventions against the Inventory, Help and Options buttons being displayed behind the party selection screen have been taken;

tags.bug: [*]Solved an issue where the "Bat-Hide Pigaciae" item was turning into "Coal Shoes" after reloading the game;
[*]Some missing colliders at “Death Siege”, “House of Penance”, “On the Edge”, “Moth’s Flame”, “Into the Fire” and “Last Rites” quests have been corrected;

tags.feature: [*]Tiles indicating the reach of the “Night of the Hunter” skill now appear through objects;

tags.bug: [*]Fixed debug text when Kentish Soldier is Burned;

tags.feature: [*]Caliburn’s dialogue won’t show off-screen during the cutscene if the camera is zoomed in;

tags.bug: [*]Tablets and consumables will always apply effects on the right target;
[*]The weapon rack in the “Failed Vows” quest now drops the correct weapon;
[*]After continuing the game from a checkpoint, passive skills will apply the correct stats on the heroes.
